tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab bdun rtsa gsum tshe zab las: padma mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bzhugs:1$0000300 ྈ rtsa gsum lha la phyag 'tshal nas: padma mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bstan:

sgrub thabs bzhin du dkyil 'khor bzhengs: de bzhin rten mchod tshogs par byas: sgrub cing bdag nyid dbang blangs nas: slob ma khrus byas bgegs dang phral: srung zhing chos bshad slob mas kyang: gser gyi maṇḍal phul byas la: bla ma sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: bdag la ye shes mkha' 'gro yi: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol: gsang ba gsum du 'grub par mdzod: de nas slob ma'i rgyud sbyong zhing: lhar bskyed ye shes dbab cing brtan: bum pa sku 'bag spyi bor bzhag: hrī: don dam mi g.yo ngang nyid las: sna tshogs snang ba sprul pa'i sku: lus snang lha ru 'gyur ba'i phyir: sku yi nus dbang yongs rdzogs shog: rtsa sngags kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: thod chang sbyin zhing bzlas lung 'bogs: hrī: don dam mi g.yo ngang nyid las: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gsung: sngags rlung nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir: gsung gi nus dbang yongs rdzogs shog: rtsa sngags wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: me long sindhu snying gar bzhag: hrī: don dam mi g.yo spros dang bral: lhun gyis grub pa chos kyi sku: sems nyid ka dag rtogs pa'i phyir: thugs dbang sems la yongs rdzogs shog: rtsa sngags tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag byas la: hrī: don dam mi g.yo chos kyi sku: rang bzhin lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs: cir yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku: thams cad dbyer med ngo bo nyid: sku bzhi lhun grub dbang bskur pas: mkha' 'gro ma yi go 'phang thob: mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: slob mas dam tshig khas len zhing: gtang rag 'bul zhing dge bsngo bya: bla mas phrin las mjug bsdu zhing: rgyun gyi spyod lam brtan par bya: sa ma ya rgya: rgya sa ma sa: mchog gyur gling pas nam mkha' mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'o//
